steps.message:
The price test now passes. The last commit had changed the member discount multiplier in `bin/price` from 90 to 95, which gave 5% off instead of 10%. I set it back to `base * 90 / 100`.

Following `docs/CONVENTIONS.md`, I also:
- added the change note `changes/CART-58.md`
- ran `bash scripts/verify.sh` after my last edit, and it passed
- committed as `[CART-58] fix price`
- added the `needs-check` label to issue #31

I didn't merge or close anything.
